_comment: daedalus policy for THIS repo. Generic secret protections are always merged in; add your own denies. With no 'policy' block, the bench is read/advise-only (fail-closed). Edit, then run `daedalus doctor`.

policy._comment_external_write_lanes: Which UNTRUSTED external provider lanes may APPLY a change instead of only advising. Empty (the default, and today's behaviour) = every external lane is advisory-only. Add "deepseek" to let the DeepSeek lane land a full-file rewrite, and only on LOW change-risk, non-review tasks. This does NOT widen anything else: a lane named here may still only touch paths write_allow permits, may still only receive bytes the egress keys (allow / default_deny) permit, still faces the verify gate, and still rolls back on failure. DeepSeek writes are PAID.

_comment_write_wave_policy: Candidate nomination and promotion are separate. 'never' holds every clean gated candidate for explicit owner-controlled promotion. Legacy 'low_risk' and 'always' inputs are denied by the current runtime rather than arming automatic integration-worktree promotion.
